// diagnostic

E0644

`{name}` makes a point, which is declared only as a module binding's value

What

`{name}` makes a point, which is declared only as a module binding's value

Why

A point is the module binding it initializes: the program makes its carrier at the first read and every reader shares it, and a call in a body would make a new, anonymous carrier each time it runs

Fix

Declare it at module level (`clicked: event.point<Int>()`) and use that binding; for a value that is local by design, use `event.new`, `event.hook` or `event.decision_hook`.
